verdict.rationale: AMD's own ROCm documentation describes an official, open-source GPU computing platform (compilers, runtimes, libraries, and the HIP runtime) plus the HIP C++ programming model for building on Instinct GPUs, so the product directly delivers official SDKs. The evidence is snippet-level first-party description only. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or API docs (e.g., language bindings, versioning), independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the ROCm/HIP SDK on MI355X.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: ROCm is AMD’s open-source GPU computing platform: an end‑to‑end ecosystem of compilers, runtimes, and libraries for AI, HPC, and domain‑specific workloads.
The foundational libraries, runtimes, and tools for GPU computing on AMD hardware — math and compute libraries, communication primitives, HIP runtime, profiling and debugging tools, and more.
HIP C++ Learn the HIP programming model.
Open-source collections of ROCm-accelerated libraries for building high-performance domain-specific applications.
